name: Kairos
description: Put a live Kairos node to work on a real project: model the domain as a context-resolved causal graph, admit edges on evidence, operate on it, and feed conformance findings back to Kairos.

creates.description: Connection record: node URL, /meta snapshot, readiness, version, auth mode and agent auth path (no secrets)
Candidate edge proposals with proposer, source sha256 and recorded_at; never admitted edges
Point-in-time evidence bundles and client-side gate results per candidate edge
Review packets (JSON per review-packet.schema.json plus Markdown render) and recorded decisions
Operational decision receipts: resolve, intervene and counterfactual responses with request hashes
Observation intents and receipts keyed by durable idempotency keys
Conformance claims and probe runs against the configured node
Conformance findings, friction and bugs with command, output, doc citation and expected vs observed
Pilot plans, gate records and pilot reports
